Analysis: New Data Exfiltration Toolkit Observed in the Wild

Researchers monitoring underground forums have identified a new data exfiltration toolkit being discussed among threat actors, reportedly used in several recent breaches targeting financial services organizations.

Technical Notes

The toolkit reportedly uses DNS tunneling for command-and-control communication, making network-level detection more difficult for defenders relying solely on traditional signature-based tools.
